weekend_note: Today (Sunday) has showers likely, about 60%, so lean indoors: Ice Flyers hockey at 4:05 PM or Rocky Horror at Pensacola Little Theatre (runs through Nov 8). Monday and Tuesday look mostly dry, with another wet spell Wednesday (about 60%) for the First City Lights kickoff and the Palafox holiday market. Next weekend is the best of the stretch, mostly sunny and in the mid 70s: the free Blue Angels Homecoming Air Show Nov 6-7, the Great Gulfcoast Arts Festival and the Greek Festival Nov 6-8. Storm recovery from Isaias is still affecting some events, so double-check before heading out.

news.title: Pensacola Beach short-term rental rules up for possible vote Nov. 4
news.summary: The Santa Rosa Island Authority is weighing a draft requiring annual registration, inspection records, a 24/7 contact who responds within an hour, and a three-strike rule. The board meets at 5 PM Nov 4.

news.title: FEMA individual assistance approved for Escambia and seven other counties

news.title: Storm-recovery job demand expected to last about six more months

news.title: TSA PreCheck enrollment at Pensacola airport Nov 3 to 6

news.title: City park and facility closures continue after Isaias
